newsitem.title: USA: BroadBand Tech adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: BroadBand Tech adopts rights plan.

text.p: BroadBand Technologies Inc said on Thursday that it has adopted a shareholder rights plan to protect shareholders from hostile takeover attempts.
Under the plan, preferred stock purchase rights will be issued to shareholders at for each share held on December 23, 1996. The rights will expire November 19, 2006, the company said.

BroadBand said the rights plan would dilute the interests of a person attempting to takeover the company if the terms of the acquiring company's offer are deemed not to be in the best interests of shareholders.
Representatives were not immediately available to say what would put the rights plan into effect.
